key.name: style-scheme-id
key.description: Empty string means no explicit override.

key.name: show-line-numbers
key.summary: Show line numbers in the editor
key.description: If true, the editor displays line numbers in the gutter.

key.name: show-spell-checking
key.summary: Show spell checking in the editor
key.description: If true, misspelled words are underlined in the editor.

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the window was maximized at close
key.description: If true, startup restores maximized state.

key.name: tiny-close-streak
key.summary: Consecutive closes with tiny window size
key.description: Counts consecutive closes below the minimum recommended size.

key.name: custom-card-link-kinds
key.summary: Custom graph link kinds used in the add-link dialog
key.description: User-defined card link kinds shown alongside default presets.

key.name: git-github-username
key.summary: Last used GitHub username in guided setup
key.description: Used to prefill the guided Git sync setup for subsequent projects.
